rows.grounds: indeclinable indicating total pervasion or all directions
a covering or containing closure; ritual-yogic sealing
absolutive expressing prior completed action of placing or giving
causes bewilderment or concealment; optative expressing potential or prescribed effect
qualifies Śiva as the highest reality
the supreme consciousness or deity as object of the action

items.question: What effect does Kuṇḍalī's universal enclosure have upon supreme Śiva?
premises: Kuṇḍalī acts in the presence of Śiva.
An enclosure is placed everywhere by Kuṇḍalī.
This all-encompassing enclosure produces delusion or concealment.
items.inference: By placing a universal enclosure, Kuṇḍalī deludes or conceals supreme Śiva.
uncertainties: Whether mohayet implies concealment, bewilderment, or absorption is context-dependent.
The subject Kuṇḍalī is carried over from the preceding verse and not explicit in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having placed an enclosure everywhere, she deludes the supreme Śiva.
